answer: Run a ferrous audit lottery: each new identity pays a small fee into a pool, and random established peers audit its claimed work, recording verdicts on a public ledger anyone can re-check. Auditors earn only when their verdict matches the majority and lose standing for rubber-stamping fakes, so approving a clone army means bribing many independent reviewers. Like an ocean, the ledger is too broad for one actor to drain or rewrite, and only identities that survive repeated audits reach the summit of full rights. Limit: cap approvals per auditor so wealth alone cannot buy many seats.
